MMAD 2026

Multimodal Anomaly Detection Workshop 2026 February 2, 2026 · Aalborg, Denmark

Registration is closed. Deadline: Jan 28th, 2026.

Travel grants for early-stage researchers are available. Deadline: Dec 31st, 2025.

Anomaly detection is highly important in many machine learning-driven fields, yet developing mostly independently for different data modalities such as audio, EEG signals, images, text, videos or time-series in general. This workshop aims at bringing together experts in anomaly detection from different communities and at promoting joint research activities of its members.

MMAD 2026 is a P1 workshop.
